hero.heading: Highlands County School Calendar 2026-2027
hero.mobileDescription: School starts August 11 and ends May 27. Winter break begins December 23; January 7-8 may become hurricane make-up days.

editorialSummary.heading: A late-December break, with January dates to keep flexible
paragraphs: Highlands County students attend through Tuesday, December 22, 2026, with a two-hour early release before winter break begins December 23. The named vacation continues through January 6. January 7 and 8 are separate student holidays, but the district may use them as hurricane make-up contact days. If those holidays stay in place, students return Monday, January 11, after a planned 19-day stretch away from regular classes. Check district instructions before committing to travel at the end of that break.

There are shorter stretches to plan around, too. October 15 has early release before an October 16 student holiday that can also become a make-up day. Thanksgiving is November 21-29, including both weekends. In February, students leave early February 11 and have February 12 off; classes are scheduled on February 15. Spring break runs March 13-21, followed by four scheduled class days before the separate March 26 holiday. The year finishes Thursday, May 27, with early release. Families should also note that report cards have distribution windows, including January 11-22, rather than one districtwide handout date.
highlights: Students begin August 11 and finish May 27.
Winter break starts December 23; January 7-8 may become contact days.
Six two-hour early releases are scheduled.
Spring break is March 13-21; March 26 is a separate holiday.

about.dataSource: The supplied one-page Highlands County 2026-2027 PDF is the annual date source. A complete district calendar image published with Sebring High’s May 18 announcement was also reviewed and agrees with its dates, legend, approval and make-up rules. Direct Google downloads timed out, so remote PDF byte identity has not been established. Current available official News and Live Feed content provides school-specific schedule context.
about.processing: Read extracted text and the full rendered page. Red underlined dates mean two-hour early release; vertical stripes mean nine-week endings, yellow means holiday and diagonal strokes mean no school for students with teacher work/development. August 26, September 23, October 15, December 22, February 11 and May 27 are the six early releases. The first four dates named in the hurricane conversion rule exclude December 22 and May 27, leaving August 26/September 23/October 15/February 11 eligible for full-day conversion. They remain attendance dates, with the rule recorded in notes rather than in conditional no-school IDs. October 16, April 23 and January 7-8 are the four additional possible contact dates and retain explicit published-no-class conditional fields. Preserve the printed make-up priority: eligible early releases, October 16, April 23, then January 7-8; do not replace it with chronological order or invent an order within the January pair. February 12 is a fixed student holiday, not a listed hurricane reserve; February 15 is white/scheduled attendance. Thanksgiving November 21-29 and Spring Break March 13-21 already include weekends. Winter has separate official December 23-31 and January 1-6 captions; retain both. Its planned continuous span includes conditional January 7-8 and the following weekend, so the weekday-off count is withheld and January 11 return is explicitly conditional/derived. December 21-22 are attendance. Do not bridge March 22-25 to the March 26 holiday. Report cards are three distribution windows, not daily issue events or closures. Keep January 11-22 intact as the printed reporting window with an explicit January 18 holiday caveat. Merge only the truly adjacent March 29-31 and April 1-2 captions into a derived five-weekday reporting range. February 11 early release and progress reports share one canonical event. December 22 also ends the second nine weeks and explicitly the semester; May 27 combines last day, early release and fourth-nine-week end without inventing a separately labeled semester end. Derived baseline attendance is 208 weekdays minus 25 fixed closures and four scheduled student-free reserves, or 179; no annual total is printed. Pre-year staff dates, May 28 workday and post-year May 31 holiday are excluded. October 7, 2025 printed Board approval is used; April 2026 PDF metadata is not an announced revision. The 2026-2027 Lake Placid High bell graphic and full April 27 notice establish school-scoped regular hours, including study hall exemptions; no generic district clock or inferred exemption arrival time is published. Date-specific September 23 Lake Placid 1:30 and October 15 Sebring 1:25 releases stay in their event notes, not as a current districtwide clock. The August 26 bus/afterschool-care notice is date-scoped; later childcare availability is not assumed.

faqs.question: When does school start in Highlands County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Students begin Tuesday, August 11, 2026. Check your school’s arrival information and bus route before the first morning.

faqs.question: What is the last day of school in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027, with a two-hour early release. It also ends the fourth nine weeks. May 28 is a teacher workday after students finish.

faqs.question: Is there a fall break in October 2026?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists a student holiday on Friday, October 16, following early release on Thursday, October 15. That gives a planned October 16-18 long weekend, with classes scheduled October 19. October 16 can become a hurricane make-up contact day, so keep it flexible rather than treating it as a guaranteed vacation day.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in 2026?
faqs.answer: The calendar’s holiday runs November 21-29, 2026, including both weekends. Students have no classes November 23-27, and classes are scheduled to resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do students return in January?
faqs.answer: Winter break runs December 23, 2026-January 6, 2027. January 7-8 are separate student holidays that may be used as hurricane make-up days. If those dates stay student-free, classes resume Monday, January 11. The planned continuous time off is December 23-January 10; check district notices before relying on the January return.

faqs.question: Is there school on December 21 or December 22?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are scheduled student attendance days. Tuesday, December 22, has a two-hour early release and ends the first semester. Winter break begins Wednesday, December 23.

faqs.question: When is spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 13-21, 2027, including both weekends. The five no-class weekdays are March 15-19. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Is the March 26 holiday part of spring break?
faqs.answer: It is a separate holiday on Friday, March 26, 2027. March 22-25 are scheduled school days between spring break and that holiday. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, March 29, after the holiday weekend.

faqs.question: Do students have a February break or Presidents Day off?
faqs.answer: Students are off Friday, February 12, 2027, for a teacher workday, giving them a February 12-14 long weekend. Thursday, February 11, has early release. Monday, February 15, is a scheduled school day; the calendar does not mark it as a holiday.

faqs.question: Which individual student holidays are listed?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists September 7, 2026 (Labor Day); January 18, 2027 (MLK Day); March 26 and April 23, 2027, as holidays, along with the named breaks. October 16, January 7-8 and February 12 are student holidays for teacher work or development. October 16, January 7-8 and April 23 may become hurricane make-up contact days.

faqs.question: Is there school on Veterans Day?
faqs.answer: Wednesday, November 11, 2026, is a scheduled school day under the published calendar. It is not marked as a student holiday or early-release date. Follow school messages for any later change.

faqs.question: Which dates have two-hour early release?
faqs.answer: The six dates are August 26, September 23, October 15 and December 22, 2026, and February 11 and May 27, 2027. All are student attendance dates. The hurricane plan may turn the first three and February 11 into full days; December 22 and May 27 are expressly exempt from that conversion.

faqs.question: How should families plan pickup, buses and childcare on early-release days?
faqs.answer: Plan for dismissal two hours before the school’s usual time, and confirm any date-specific instructions. The district’s August 26 reminder said buses would also arrive home two hours earlier and elementary afterschool care was available for pre-registered students. Check with your school about care on other dates and watch for any hurricane-related switch to a full day.

faqs.question: What is the hurricane make-up order?
faqs.answer: The printed plan first converts eligible early-release dates to full days, excluding December 22 and May 27. It then lists October 16 as a student contact day, followed by April 23, then January 7 and January 8. This is the published priority even though the January dates come earlier on the calendar than April 23. Follow district notices to find out which changes are needed.

faqs.question: When do progress reports go home?
faqs.answer: Progress reports are listed for September 11 and November 13, 2026, and February 11 and April 22, 2027. February 11 is also a scheduled early-release attendance day.

faqs.question: When are report cards sent home?
faqs.answer: The calendar gives distribution windows of October 19-23, 2026; January 11-22, 2027; and March 29-April 2, 2027. These are windows for school reporting, not a promise of a new report every day. The January window includes the January 18 school holiday, so confirm your school’s release date or online availability. A final fourth-quarter report-card date is not listed.

faqs.question: When do the grading periods and first semester end?
faqs.answer: The four nine-week periods end October 9 and December 22, 2026, and March 12 and May 27, 2027. December 22 is explicitly marked as the semester ending. October 9 and March 12 are grading milestones without a listed early release; December 22 and May 27 have two-hour early release.

faqs.question: How many student days are scheduled in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The published baseline gives 179 student attendance dates by calculation: 208 weekdays between August 11 and May 27, less 25 fixed no-class weekdays and four scheduled student-free make-up candidates. The PDF does not print an annual student-day total. Activated contact days would add attendance dates; turning an early release into a full day adds time to an existing attendance date.

faqs.question: What are Lake Placid High School’s regular hours?
faqs.answer: The posted 2026-2027 A/B-day and C-day schedules both run from 8:34 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. A/B days begin with study hall, and exemption rules apply. Confirm your student’s individual reporting requirements with the school. These hours apply to Lake Placid High, not every Highlands County school.

faqs.question: Where can families find graduation and school-specific events?
faqs.answer: The annual PDF does not give 2027 graduation dates or separate senior attendance deadlines. Check announcements from Avon Park High, Lake Placid High, Sebring High or Highlands Virtual for the relevant ceremony and senior instructions. School news and live feeds also carry campus-specific schedule reminders.

faqs.question: Where can I open the official calendar and check for changes?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF button for the supplied district Google Drive calendar, and check the district Calendar page for current calendar information. Watch district News, Live Feed and messages from your school for revisions, hurricane make-up instructions and school-specific release times.
